neet_che_u09_t01_1.working: The block is set by the subshell (s, p, d or f) that receives the last, differentiating electron.

neet_che_u09_t01_2.working: [Ar]3d5 4s1 is Cr. For a d-block element, group = (n-1)d + ns electrons = 5 + 1 = 6.

neet_che_u09_t01_3.working: This is Te. Highest shell n = 5 gives period 5. The last electron enters 5p, so it is p-block. Group = 10 + 2 + 4 = 16.

neet_che_u09_t01_4.working: s-block: reactive metals with low ionization enthalpy (A-II). p-block: contains metals, non-metals and metalloids (B-IV). d-block: variable oxidation states, coloured ions, paramagnetism (C-III). f-block: inner transition elements including transuranium elements (D-I).

neet_che_u09_t01_5.working: A, B and C are true. D is false because metallic character decreases across a period. E is false because the representative elements are the s- and p-block, not s- and d-block.
